caseName: National Ass'n for the Advancement of Colored People v. Claiborne Hardware Co.
caseNameFull: National Association for the Advancement of Colored People v. Claiborne Hardware Co.

opinions.text:
Sup. Ct. Miss. Certiorari granted and case set for oral argument in tandem with No. 81-280, General Building Contractors Assn., Inc. v. Pennsylvania et al. [certiorari granted, ante, p. 939], and related cases.

Justice Marshall took no part in the consideration or decision of this petition.
